purpose: Requirements for designing forge user-invocable skills as orchestrators that delegate detailed work, to avoid God-Skill problems and define data hand-off and completion flow.
summary: Background: God-Skill problems of single-context execution (context use, accuracy, no parallelism, loss)
Target skills using orchestrator plus delegation (start-design, start-plan, start-implement, start-requirements, review)
FNC-001: orchestrators manage flow and dialogue; delegate details; call query skills directly without an Agent in between
FNC-003: reference documents given to agents must be self-contained, placed in plugins/forge/docs
FNC-004: independent steps run in parallel; results passed by return value; minimal prompt data
FNC-005: format choice, JSON for machine-processed plans, Markdown for requirements and designs
FNC-006: common completion flow of review, ToC update and commit for document-generating skills
FNC-007: user input interpretation is done by AI, not by argument-parsing scripts
Table of data hand-off methods per skill
tasks: Designing a new user-invocable forge skill
Deciding what an orchestrator delegates to agents or skills
Choosing JSON or Markdown for a managed document
Implementing completion processing of document-generating skills
Handling command argument interpretation in skills
title: REQ-001 オーケストレータパターン要件
